Calf Motor Dash.name: Calf Motor Dash
Calf Motor Dash.description: The user accelerates through their calf engines and crosses up to fifty meters of clear ground in a few seconds this turn. This reaches cover or closes a gap before an ordinary runner catches up. The user needs traction and a visible braking area; obstacles do not move aside, and a sudden turn at full speed risks a collision. Strain: light.
